The grid uses gbase 0.1.3 and gscore 0.1.1 on frozen gsim-derived effects and artificial-LD genotypes. Each synthetic set contains 500 SNPs. Available SNP count and the number actually contributing to set scores are distinct. Weights are fixed, coding is standardized, and completed scores are unscaled. Each of 40 cells is one execution; the grid supplies bounded workload sensitivity, not repeated-run confidence intervals or a universal scaling law. Preparation and loading precede the operation clock; peaks cover the entire R worker including serialization. No UK Biobank data or new model fitting is used for scoring.

## Additional simulated scoring workloads

| Operation | Simulated workload | Threads requested | Wall time | Process peak memory |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Total score | Artificial-LD panel; 2,000 recipients; 50,000 SNPs | 1 | 8.03 s | 192.3 MiB |
| Three synthetic pathway scores | Artificial-LD panel; 2,000 recipients; 50,000 SNPs | 1 | 6.30 s | 192.8 MiB |
| Total score | Artificial-LD panel; 2,000 recipients; 50,000 SNPs | 4 | 3.23 s | 192.9 MiB |
| Three synthetic pathway scores | Artificial-LD panel; 2,000 recipients; 50,000 SNPs | 4 | 2.66 s | 192.7 MiB |
| Total score | 1000G-derived gsim panel; 2,000 recipients; 5,360 SNPs | 1 | 1.03 s | 157.2 MiB |
| Three synthetic pathway scores | 1000G-derived gsim panel; 2,000 recipients; 5,360 SNPs | 1 | 2.41 s | 157.8 MiB |

The artificial-LD panel uses binomial/block-copy genotypes and gsim phenotypes; the reference-derived panel uses gsim founders from 503 EUR donors on chr22. Effects and memberships are simulated. Operation clocks exclude preparation, loading and serialization; memory covers the complete R process including loading/saving. Requested thread counts are limits; observed worker counts were not recorded. Each setting is one execution. These workloads are distinct from the controlled grid above.

A separate 50,000-marker workload scored a total plus 20 artificial gene-marker sets in **14.88 s** at one thread and **5.31 s** at four threads; peak memory was not recorded for that workload.
